receipt: v3 static design mockup (tbound-redesign-v3.html), frames refreshed to the final running UI (C3)

method.frames: Each frame is the root DOM of the live /app/ state (demo gateway), serialised by serialize-root.js: innerHTML-like, except that two adjacent text nodes keep an empty comment between them, so the split text runs that React creates lay out as they do live. The frames sit under the built stylesheet of the same build (dist/assets/index-BPWS4mwk.css, verbatim). Hand-written: the review area, the gallery, the record copy and the mock-only CSS. The two scrolled phone frames are shown at the absolute scroll offset recorded for the live page (the live capture JSON, screenshots[].scrollY).
method.build: node build-mock-c3.mjs (reads the frozen sources, the built CSS, the captured frame DOM and the parts; writes only the mockup).
method.capture: node real-c3.mjs (live capture, Chrome headless over CDP, one frame per state, empty storage per state, theme by localStorage, actions as real pointer presses) and node mock-c3.mjs (mockup at the same viewport, theme and emulation). The pointer is left where the live press ended, so :hover matches. Each live frame is read 1 s after its last pointer action, so the press has finished painting before the frame is captured. The comparison view hides only the review area, from the first layout (an adopted style sheet). Chrome runs with the flags listed in chrome.flags (--disable-lcd-text: without it each phone dock frame differed by about 3000 pixels from its live capture, with it by about 700; the flag is the only one kept, because the hinting and colour-profile flags changed nothing). For a whole-page frame, the visible file is the comparison image.
method.comparison: Byte comparison of the PNG of each frame (review area hidden) with the live PNG of the same state (sha256). Pixel statistics from a canvas diff of the two PNGs. Text and rectangle diffs of the regions (header, nav, main, footer, composer, scrim, governance aside) read with the same expression on both sides.
